description: The Åland statistics and research office publishes its housing and construction statistics, built from registers in the way Nordic countries run a register census, in a PxWeb database. One table counts buildings every year from 1995 to 2025 by use and by main heat source, splitting district heating, oil or gas, wood or peat, electricity and ground source heat; in 2025 it lists 13,350 buildings, of which 1,054 use district heating and 4,087 electricity. Other tables count dwellings for each municipality by construction period and by amenities such as sewer connection, piped water, WC, central heating and hot water, and by rooms, house type, floor area and tenure, plus building production and permits. Coverage is the whole autonomous region of Åland. Format and access: free PxWeb interface and API returning CSV, JSON, PX or Excel, no key. Licence: not stated on the pages read. Caveats: the heat source table is only for Åland as a whole; labels are in Swedish and some category names are misspelt in the source. Simulation uses: heating mix of the building stock for energy transition and district heating planning, and dwelling age and amenities for water and sewer network studies. Related records: none for Åland in the catalogue.

schema_summary: BY007 buildings by year, use (residential, commercial, office, transport, care, assembly, education, industrial, storage, other) and heat source (district heating, oil or gas, wood, peat or coke, electricity, ground source heat, other or unknown). BY006 buildings by use and construction year. BO005 dwellings by municipality, construction period (before 1920 to 2010s), year and amenities (sewer, piped water, WC, central heating, hot water, laundry, sauna). BO002 to BO006 dwellings by rooms, house type, floor area and tenure. BY001 and BY003 housing production and new or rebuilt buildings.
